overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no violation: the Board conceded it did not record the revision's posting date and time, but the revision was posted more than 48 hours before the meeting, so the requirement did not apply.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a revised notice for the Sept 18 meeting did not conspicuously record the revision's posting date and time, or the original posting date and time.
allegations.key_passage: The requirement does not apply here, however, because the revision was posted more than 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
